name: Barrow Guard
shortDescription: Peat-and-bone that is not a dog.
lookDescription: A peat-and-bone shape keeps the barrow mouth, not quite a dog and not quite still.
examineDescription: Packed peat over old bone, about the size of a large dog and shaped roughly like one. It has no mouth to bark with. It does not pace or circle. It stands in the gap and turns its head to follow you. Beat it, and Wren should hear before Alder does.
lockNarration: Peat packs tighter over the bone.
victoryNarration: The Barrow Guard slumps into wet peat. The hill-lip is only a door again.
